updates: Add explicit fabrication_maturity and verified_advantage descriptors.
Do not infer maturity or quantum advantage from funding, valuation, roadmap, or company statements alone.
Keep production quantum execution disabled pending independent evidence.
Test missing or mismatched model signatures and untrusted issuers.
Test component self-authorization attempts and forbidden capability admission.
Test external form submission denial, cross-domain consent, target substitution, and single-use approval replay.
Test physical simulation gate, raw-sensor retention denial, and receipt signature/hash verification.
Test that funding or valuation claims cannot establish verified quantum advantage.
Enforce exactly five distinct news items and preserve source publication dates.
Keep primary-source links distinct from secondary confirmation.
Store image query metadata and only embed direct image URLs when source availability is confirmed.
Produce a SHA3-256 manifest digest and Ed25519-signed proposal-only effect receipt.
Record no-change decisions when evidence does not justify a runtime change.
Normalize accessibility modality labels before policy evaluation.
Reject raw-sensor retention requests and emit only minimized intent metadata.
Add fixtures for visual/sign/voice/text modality paths with retention disabled.
Persist communication preferences only after explicit user consent.
Keep raw audio, video, and biometric sensor payloads out of long-term preference memory.
Expose review, edit, and reset semantics for stored preference metadata.
Require explicit user choice before changing output modality.
Treat outbound voice/text transmission as an external write requiring scoped human approval.
Use single-use credentials bound to principal, action, resource, and target domain.
Verify signed model provenance from a trusted issuer; do not sign a model manifest with a key supplied by the model under test.
Require component admission before runtime and forbid authority-granting component capabilities.
Deny external writes by default; require explicit, target-bound human approval for sensitive transitions.
Require physical simulation before any live physical effect.
Emit Ed25519-signed receipts over SHA3-256 canonical records.
